04 GOOD TO KNOW

A FEW GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Clear answers.
A better place to begin.

PPF or ceramic coating — what’s the difference?

PPF is a physical protective film installed over paint. Ceramic coating is a liquid-applied surface treatment; it is not the same physical barrier. They serve different purposes, and suitability depends on your paint, priorities and coverage. Ask which option makes sense for your vehicle.

Can I bring my bike in for a wash or detail?

Yes — bike washing and detailing are included in our service inquiries. Share your motorcycle’s model, condition and the areas you’d like to focus on. Confirm the exact service scope and availability directly before visiting.

What does sunroof coating include?

The precise treatment and coverage need to be confirmed with Ocean Car Spa. Tell us whether you mean a coating for the glass or another sunroof-related treatment. Product suitability and compatibility with your vehicle should be checked before proceeding.

What should I check before choosing sun film?

Discuss glass compatibility, visibility and the applicable local rules before choosing a film. Availability and permitted installation scope need to be checked directly; no blanket legal or performance guarantee is implied.

How do I get a price or arrange a visit?

Build an inquiry below, copy it and send it to our Instagram profile, or call +91 77788 66972. Pricing depends on the vehicle, its condition and the agreed service scope. This website does not send inquiries or make bookings; arrange and confirm a visit directly with Ocean Car Spa.
